title: Fix the cross-feature-deep-import checker (Makefile audit 15/15) — its awk logic can never fire

evidence.quote: awk -F: '{match($$1, /features\/([^\/]+)\//, a); match($$0, /features\/([^\/]+)\//, b); if(a[1] != b[1]) print}'
awk -F: '{match($$1, /features\/([^\/]+)\//, a); match($$0, /features\/([^\/]+)\//, b); if(a[1] != b[1]) print}';
echo "16/17 — No raw profile.mode string comparisons (use ProfileMode enum) (W5.10)"; \
echo "18/18 — No direct FirestoreGateway.push* outside lib/core/sync/ (Plan §F Phase 5 deliverable 8 — no-direct-gateway-push)"; \
echo "20/22 — No raw curriculumId/storageKey rendered in Text() (render via CurriculumLabel / rendered*ForRef)"; \

why: The awk derives BOTH the importing-file's feature name and the imported feature name from $0, which is the full grep -rn output line beginning with the FILE PATH — so match($0,...) always finds the importer's OWN feature name (from the path prefix) before ever reaching the import statement, making a[1]!=b[1] always false. Verified by feeding the exact grep -rn output line for pending_local_signup.dart through the isolated awk: it printed 'SUPPRESSED (bug present)'. Because of this, Rule 2 has zero real enforcement repo-wide despite 'make audit' reporting 15/15 clean, and two concrete violations sit undetected in this batch alone: pending_local_signup.dart (a domain/services file) reaches directly into a different feature's presentation/providers instead of a barrel — profiles' own barrel (features/profiles/profiles.dart) is an empty stub with nothing exported, so there was no barrel path available — and onboarding_screen.dart in a different feature deep-imports account's onboarding_intent_screen.dart because account.dart's barrel doesn't export it.
recommendation: Fix the awk to extract the imported-feature name from the import-statement TEXT only (e.g. split the grep -rn line on the first ':' twice to isolate the content, or use grep -oP 'features/\K[^/]+' scoped to the substring after the import path's package: prefix) so it stops reading the file-path prefix. Then resolve the two concrete violations: export a currentAccountId-style accessor from features/profiles/profiles.dart and import through it, and export OnboardingIntentStep from features/account/account.dart. Add a tiny fixture-based regression so a bad cross-feature import always reproduces a checker failure.
acceptance_criteria: Feeding a synthetic 'file/features/A/x.dart:N:import ...features/B/y.dart' line through the fixed awk prints the line (not suppressed)
make audit check 15/15 stops being silently no-op and either fails on the two known violations or passes because they were fixed
pending_local_signup.dart and onboarding_screen.dart no longer deep-import another feature's non-barrel path

corrections: The profiles.dart evidence line is off by one: "library profiles;" is actually at line 7, not line 6 as quoted (line 6 is a trailing comment). Immaterial to the finding — the barrel-is-empty claim and the awk-suppression claim are both independently confirmed correct.
